newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates KE Int'l notes with warrants AA-minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates KE Int'l notes with warrants AA-minus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp has assigned an AA-minus rating to KE International Ltd's 127 million Swiss franc secured notes with warrants due November 2000, S&P said Tuesday.

The rating is based primarily on the lower of the ratings of the underlying collateral provided by Korea Electric Power Corp (Kepco), which is rated AA-minus, and AA-plus rated Swiss Bank Corp, which is the swap counterparty, special account holder, security agent and custodian for the notes.
As such, any rating change for these companies may translate into a corresponding rating change on KE International's notes with warrants, S&P said.
